title: Weather station with custom interfaces
purpose: Explain article's push-style custom Subject Observer DisplayElement classes.
alt: WeatherData의 Subject 구현과 Observer·DisplayElement를 구현한 세 디스플레이의 측정값 푸시 갱신
requiredChecks: Custom Subject, Observer and DisplayElement interfaces show correct methods.
WeatherData implements Subject and keeps observer list plus temperature/humidity/pressure/getters/measurementsChanged.
CurrentConditionDisplay, StatisticsDisplay, ForecastDisplay implement both Observer and DisplayElement.
notifyObservers pushes update(temp,humidity,pressure) to registered displays; each display can render via display().
Displays can register/remove via Subject; not Java Observable inheritance.
